name: Aiba Julia
source:
The senior who ate the protagonist to silence them after learning a secret. Pure at heart, yet extreme and bold in action.

The type who can handle anything, even without experience. Bright yet rational. Calm yet passionate. Believes they will become Prime Minister someday.

[From [url=http://www.ole-m.net/products/senpai/chara/chara.htmll] official site[/url]]
